payload.title: The aria-adapters test target's cache inputs name only Dockerfile and compose globs outside the four infrastructure roots, so a classified terraform, nginx, nats, k8s or helm file added under apps, libs, web, platform, e2e, sens-api-gateway or scripts does not invalidate the cached result of the invariant that would fail on it
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/infrastructure-policy-adapter.test.ts:1418-1433 (the invariant reads git ls-files at run time, which nx does not track as an input)
tools/gates/lib/infra/classify.ts:14-24 (the nine formats: dockerfile, compose, k8s, helm_values, helm_chart, helm_template, terraform, nginx, nats)
nx.json:26-30 (the test target default inputs add only the project's own files and ^production)
payload.rule_violated: A gate must run when the facts it judges change (CLAUDE.md: make the wrong behaviour detectable at test time); the invariant's trigger is a hand list that is not tied to the classifier it checks.
payload.notes: Checked with the kernel glob matcher against the input list: apps/x/Dockerfile and apps/x/docker-compose.dev.yml match an input, but apps/x/prod.override.yml, apps/x/k8s/deploy.yaml, libs/x/kustomization.yaml, apps/x/values.yaml, apps/x/helm/Chart.yaml, apps/x/charts/templates/a.tpl, libs/x/main.tf, web/x/nginx.conf and apps/x/nats/nats.conf match none. A pull request that adds such a file under a new root changes no input of aria-adapters:test, so nx affected skips it or serves the cached green result, while the invariant at line 1431 would have gone red; the file then lands unread (see the walk-wider-than-scope finding). The commit claim that the inputs now follow the classifier holds for two of nine formats. Close condition: Derive the project.json test inputs from the classifier (a root-agnostic glob per format, or a single input over the seven new roots) and add a test that every classifyInfraFile format has at least one matching input glob, so a new format cannot be added without its cache trigger. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 2b). Verified at head b2259fe03f of open pull request #2151; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
